title: Pacing to Maintain Physiologic Ventricular Activation
official: Pacing for Cardiac Resynchronisation Using the Intrinsic Conduction System to Maintain Physiologic Ventricular Activation
summary: Right ventricular pacing causes ventricular dyssynchrony and may be associated with impaired outcome. In the last decade, several approaches for more physiological pacing became available and were implemented in the latest guidelines. However, compared to conventional device implantation, cardiac resynchronization, His bundle pacing and left bundle area pacing remain demanding procedures in the individual case. Goal of the single center observational "Pace conduct" study is to evaluate implantation success, safety and outcome of pacing methods that maintain physiologic ventricular activation.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Pacemaker or ICD Implantation aiming to avoid pacing induced ventricular dyssynchrony according to current guidelines
* age \>= 18 years

Exclusion Criteria:

* no informed consent for the procedure given
* no follow-up data
